status: Finalized executor evidence; final review dispositioned and findings registered; parent owns commit

ties.note: Magnet coil major radius is the same physical quantity as the plasma major radius. Its suffix is R0, not R, so no suffix scan will ever surface it -- the tie must be declared. Advisory here: a group holding R but not this key earns a tie_candidate warning, never an added key. Since the model migration the plasma major radius is one plant-level entry point (R), not the geom__R / rb__R fan-out.

objective_catalog.name: lcoe
objective_catalog.note: Headline levelized cost of electricity. Exit-point filename is stellaris__lcoe.json; the catalog keys on the channel, never the filename.

objective_catalog.name: lcoe_1cfe
objective_catalog.note: LCOE variant using the 1costingfe CAS90 rollup.

objective_catalog.name: cas72
objective_catalog.note: Levelized annual replacement cost -- the lifecycle calendar's output since WI-046 (2026-09-08; the retired cas72_calc__cost channel is gone).

objective_catalog.name: total_capital
objective_catalog.note: Total capital cost including interest during construction.

objective_catalog.name: cas27
objective_catalog.note: CAS27 special-materials capital, computed in-package from the radial-build blanket volume since the model migration (2026-08-21). Declared as an objective so generic verification compares it against the oracle's own recompute: on the era route this value was glue-fed to both sides and never independently verified.

objective_catalog.name: beta
objective_catalog.note: Volume-averaged thermal beta computed by 'Volume-Averaged Beta' from the profile referents and magnet__B (WI-030); replaces the retired bound input beta. Compared against the oracle's closed form so a magnet study verifies the physics lever it moves.

objective_catalog.name: magnet_capital
objective_catalog.note: CAS22.1.3 magnet capital — since WI-035 the decomposed rollup (winding pack + casing structure), the channel the plant's magnet.capital_cost reads. The old conductor-proxy lump is the separate magnet_capital_1cfe comparison objective.

objective_catalog.name: magnet_capital_1cfe
objective_catalog.note: 1cfe-form comparison channel (WI-035 D6): the retained 'Magnet Coil Cost' conductor-proxy lump, now responding to the computed field. Kept as an objective so the decomposed rollup and the calibrated lump stay observable side by side.

objective_catalog.name: p_aux_required
objective_catalog.note: WI-037 required sustained plasma-coupled heating; the sustainment_ok operand. Responds to field (~B^-2.15 through ISS04), density, temperature, geometry, and heating.

objective_catalog.name: tau_E
objective_catalog.note: WI-037 ISS04 energy confinement time (closed form, line-averaged density).

objective_catalog.name: operating_heat_coupled
objective_catalog.note: WI-050 signed operating demand at held source/coupling efficiencies.

objective_catalog.name: operating_heat_delivered
objective_catalog.note: WI-050 signed operating demand at held source/coupling efficiencies.

objective_catalog.name: operating_heat_wallplug
objective_catalog.note: WI-050 signed operating demand at held source/coupling efficiencies.

oracle.note: Package-owned oracle seam. evaluate(point) takes a mapping of qualified entry keys to floats and returns a mapping of qualified channel names to floats; it wraps the independent pure-Python oracle verify_stellaris.py, which is imported and never modified. The module also publishes a fixed-name companion, operand_bindings() -> {constraint_id: {source_name: {kind, key}}}, which says which qualified input key or channel each predicate operand means. A generic verifier requires both and fails closed on anything unresolved: on this package one operand of five constraints resolves to nothing by name at all, so a tool that inferred bindings would compare the wrong number and read as a pass.
